name: Form Oversized Tee
subtitle: Dropped shoulder, boxy body
description: Our signature oversized silhouette. A wide, squared body with a dropped shoulder and a sleeve that settles just above the elbow — cut to hang with intent rather than simply run large.
details: Dense cotton jersey with a soft, dry hand
Ribbed crew neck that holds its shape
Dropped shoulder seam and elbow-length sleeve
fitNotes: Oversized through the body and shoulder
Take your usual size for the intended fit
Size down for a closer, boxy look
